notes.title: Space Hole 2018: Patch 5
notes.notes:
* Updates to the lounge! It should run more stably now.  Warning: the Lounge is a work in progress :)

Thanks!
-Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole 2018: Lounge (v1) Update! (Patch 4)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This patch adds:

* [b]New Feature:[/b] experimental "Lounge" mode to main menu https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XpN4K-RpzCg

* Bug fixes to enable camera modes (F1-F4) in more levels in Fungal Expansion
* Added Scroll Lock hotkey to disable/enable mouse lock (to make the game more compatible with Mhook)

Thanks!
-Sam Atlas

notes.title: Space Hole Patch 3

notes.title: Space Hole 2018 Update 2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Here's the second batch of updates :)

* Added "area clear" text to cleared levels in the Warp
* Updated Segmentation zone (new holes, bug fixes, new push-gates)
* Tweaked the tutorial to give more focus to the most important information

Have fun!
-Sam Atlas
